purpose: Compliance matrix consumed by Vizzie to (a) decide whether a dataset may be ingested, (b) render required attribution on maps, embeds and exports, (c) set per-portal crawl rates.

ingest_policy_values.allow: Ingest and serve normally with attribution.
ingest_policy_values.allow_with_flag: Ingest, but surface a share-alike warning to the user before export/publish.
ingest_policy_values.link_only: Do NOT ingest. Show metadata and link to the source portal.
ingest_policy_values.block: Do not surface for ingest at all.

resolution_order: 1. Dataset-level licence from the portal API (normalised via licence_aliases).
2. If absent/unmappable -> portal.default_licence (only where the portal publishes a blanket licence).
3. If still absent -> UNDECLARED (ingest policy: link_only).
usage.attribution: Render licences[<id>].attribution_template with {title} {publisher} {retrieved}. Attribution is non-removable at every tier for the SOURCE; only Vizzie branding is removable.

CC-BY-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0
CC-BY-4.0.attribution_template: {title} © {publisher}, licensed CC BY 4.0. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie. Reformatted and geocoded.

CC-BY-3.0-AU.name: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Australia
CC-BY-3.0-AU.attribution_template: {title} © {publisher}, licensed CC BY 3.0 AU. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie.

US-PD.name: US Government Public Domain (17 USC §105)
US-PD.note: Public domain in the US only; may attract copyright in other jurisdictions. Attribute anyway as good practice.

OGL-UK-3.0.name: Open Government Licence v3.0 (UK)
OGL-UK-3.0.attribution_template: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: {publisher}. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie.

OGL-Canada-2.0.name: Open Government Licence – Canada 2.0
OGL-Canada-2.0.attribution_template: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada. Source: {publisher}. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie.

DL-DE-BY-2.0.name: Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0
DL-DE-BY-2.0.attribution_template: {title} — {publisher}, Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung 2.0. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie.

ODbL-1.0.name: Open Database License 1.0
ODbL-1.0.note: SHARE-ALIKE. Derived databases may need to be released under ODbL. Flag before a customer builds a commercial derived product on it.

CC-BY-SA-4.0.name: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0
CC-BY-SA-4.0.attribution_template: {title} © {publisher}, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie. Reformatted and geocoded.
CC-BY-SA-4.0.note: SHARE-ALIKE — adapted material must be licensed alike. Surface a warning on export.

CC-BY-NC.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial (any version)
CC-BY-NC.note: NON-COMMERCIAL. Do not ingest — Vizzie is a commercial platform and most users are commercial. Link to source instead.

CC-BY-ND.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NoDerivatives (any version)
CC-BY-ND.note: NO DERIVATIVES. Vizzie's pipeline reformats and geocodes — that is a derivative. Do not ingest.

UNDECLARED.name: No licence declared by publisher
UNDECLARED.attribution_template: {title} — {publisher}. No licence declared by the publisher; rights status unverified. Retrieved {retrieved} via Vizzie.
UNDECLARED.note: LARGEST SINGLE CATEGORY (~16% of faceted CKAN datasets; 70%+ of data.gov.au). Absence of a licence is NOT permission. Default to link-only unless the portal declares a blanket licence in its terms — see portal.default_licence.

rate_limit.note: Most CKAN instances publish no formal limit. 2 req/s is a conservative self-imposed default. data.gov.uk explicitly states no API key and no rate limit.
